description:
Correct the booking holder's name, email or phone on a confirmed hotel booking, for example to fix a typo.

It does not change dates, rooms or guests. To show the customer prices for other dates or guests, use `post_bookings_bookingid_alternative_prebooks`.

Pass the `bookingId`, the `email` currently on the booking and the corrected `holder` (`firstName`, `lastName`, `email`, optional `phone`). Confirm the new details with the customer before calling.

Requires the `bookingId` and the `email` used to book: the server only returns or changes a booking when they match.

bookingId.description: The booking ID from the booking confirmation.

email.description: The email address currently on the booking, used to verify the customer. A new email goes in holder.email.

holder.description: The corrected booking holder. Send firstName, lastName and email even if only one of them changes.

lastName.description: The booking holder's last name, if the customer gives it. Optional.

name: put_bookings_bookingid_amend
title: Amend hotel booking
